monsterevolution-graph-label: Accessible label for an evolution graph.
monsterevolution-relationships-label: Heading and accessible label for the semantic list of graph edges.
monsterevolution-relationship: Describes a directed edge. $1 is the source monster name; $2 is the target monster name.
monsterevolution-requirements: Summary label for a list of evolution requirements.
monsterevolution-more-information: Summary label for optional node details.
monsterevolution-highlight-paths: Accessible label for a path-highlighting button. $1 is a monster name.
monsterevolution-zoom-controls: Accessible label for the group of graph controls.
monsterevolution-zoom-in: Button label that increases graph scale.
monsterevolution-zoom-out: Button label that decreases graph scale.
monsterevolution-zoom-reset: Button label that resets graph scale.
monsterevolution-zoom-fit: Button label that fits a graph into its viewport.
monsterevolution-missing-image: Image alternative text. $1 is a monster name.
monsterevolution-missing-image-short: Short visible placeholder when a file is missing.
monsterevolution-error: Generic error wrapper. $1 is a localized error detail.
monsterevolution-error-line: Error wrapper. $1 is a source line number; $2 is a localized error detail.
monsterevolution-error-generic: Generic parser detail. $1 is a controlled plain-text diagnostic.
monsterevolution-error-syntax: Syntax parser detail. $1 is a controlled plain-text diagnostic.
monsterevolution-error-limit: Limit parser detail. $1 is a controlled plain-text diagnostic.
monsterevolution-error-option: Graph-option detail. $1 is a controlled plain-text diagnostic.
monsterevolution-error-input-limit: Error shown when one definition exceeds its configured byte limit.
monsterevolution-error-node-limit: Error shown when a graph has too many nodes.
monsterevolution-error-edge-limit: Error shown when a graph has too many directed edges.
monsterevolution-error-condition-limit: Error shown when one edge has too many conditions.
monsterevolution-error-graph-limit: Error shown when one parser invocation contains too many graphs.
monsterevolution-error-empty: Error shown for an empty graph.
monsterevolution-error-duplicate-node: Error for a duplicate ID. $1 is the rejected ID.
monsterevolution-error-unknown-node: Error for an unknown endpoint. $1 is the rejected ID.
monsterevolution-error-invalid-id: Error for an invalid ID. $1 is the rejected ID.
monsterevolution-error-invalid-link: Error for a link value that looks like an external or executable URL.
monsterevolution-error-invalid-image: Error for a node image or edge-label icon that is not a safe local file title.
monsterevolution-error-unknown-attribute: Error for a non-whitelisted attribute. $1 is its name.
monsterevolution-error-category: Tracking category name for pages containing invalid graphs. Do not include the namespace prefix.
monsterevolution-missing-page-category: Tracking category name for pages whose MonsterEvolution node or arrow-label links have invalid or nonexistent internal targets. Do not include the namespace prefix.
